extracted.name: High-Protein Energy Bites
extracted.description: Oats, peanut butter, honey, flax seeds, and coconut are rolled into balls creating high-protein energy bites for a filling on-the-go snack.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder (such as Fry's®), or more as needed
instruction_lines: Mix oats, peanut butter, honey, dark chocolate chips, flax seeds, protein powder, coconut, chia seeds, and coconut extract together in a large bowl; fold in coffee beans. Form mixture into 1-inch balls.
Place cocoa powder in a small bowl. Roll each ball in the cocoa powder until coated.
